title: Semi-voiced hiragana: P row — write in kana
description: Type the hiragana spelling from a Latin-letter cue; same-sound signs specify their base sign. Kana answers only.

review.provenance: Independently authored F05 voiced and semi-voiced sign exercises, not copied from legacy CSV or mocks.
